summary: Pairing gateway discovery decodes the real native health envelope and never follows HTTP redirects.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema change; reuses the existing native value envelope.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Gateway discovery reads the node from the native response value envelope. HTTP redirects are not followed and leave the gateway unverified, producing the existing warning. The server completion-origin guard remains authoritative.

recovery.detail: Health discovery writes no persisted state.
